textIssues: In the transcription for choice 4, the tool name is written as 'CREATE - SIMPLE', with spaces around the hyphen. The official problem text JSON has 'CREATE-SIMPLE', and the tool's official name has no spaces. It should be written 'CREATE-SIMPLE'. The transcription also has a stray half-width space in 'ECETOC TRA など'. It should match the official text: 'CREATE-SIMPLEやECETOC TRAなど'.
reasonIssues: The reason for choice 1 says '比較に使う値の名称が違う' (only the name of the value being compared is different). That makes the difference sound like wording alone. The two values are different things. The first evaluation value (第一評価値) is the estimated upper 5% value (95th percentile) of the concentration distribution in the unit work area. The geometric mean is the center of that distribution. Comparing the geometric mean with the control concentration (管理濃度) would underestimate the risk. The reason should be rewritten around that point: the value is different, not just its name.
